versions.changelog: v2.0: 9-dim evaluation, category modifiers, per-dim Pareto tolerances, enriched docs
v1.1.0: Fix 4 critical pipeline bugs (Ralph Wiggum/Autoloop/Evaluator verdict), scoring overhaul (base 4->2, LLM weight 50%, semantic relevance), generator LLM-first, learner/gate/executor fixes

Initial release of the improvement-gate skill.

- Provides a 6-layer mechanical quality gate for validating change candidates.
- Rejects candidates if any layer (Schema, Compile, Lint, Regression, Review, HumanReview) fails.
- Supports manual queue management for high-risk cases requiring human approval.
- Excludes scoring, file change execution, and skill structure evaluation; these use separate skills.
- Offers CLI tools to validate gates, list pending reviews, and complete review actions.
- Outputs receipts and review artifacts in JSON format for integration.
